description: A comprehensive Python module implementing a subtitle correction pipeline. It normalizes subtitle text and timings, applies grammar and style corrections, enforces OTT compliance rules (like line length and punctuation), and supports audio-aware correction using ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) with optional transcript alignment. The module is designed to be integrated into a larger system for automated subtitle editing and correction.
